notes.title: New Update! 1337 Mode!! (Round 2)
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

Glad to announce a new update for you guys! Below is what is new! (Did this last night, but had some bugs to iron out, I am 95% sure most of the bugs are now ironed out)

+ Bug Fixes
	- Fixed bug where if the Node Hexer would start off at the first position, and would not be clickable.
	- Fixed a bug where The Dollmaker would push you through the floor
	- Fixed a bug where Lucas would kill you, and the camera would remain blurry. 
	- Fixed a bug where you could quite the game, and get full battery life back. That is now fixed. 
	- Fixed a bug where some achievements would not be activated for beating the game. Such as The Professional. 
		

+ Added 1337 Mode
	+ No saving at all. If the game crashes or if you alt f4. Sorry GG. 
	+ Threats are activated from the start of the game. 
	+ Threats will be aggressive from the start.
	+ No tutorial. 
	+ No free remote vpn at start.
	+ You will only start with 1 DOS Coin.
	+ You will be given 1 Back Door. 
	+ All hacks(except Zone Wall) will be at the hardest level.
	+ You CAN NOT force hacks. 
	
If you beat 1337 mode you will get an ultra secret ending :) 

+ Added more websites to explore! 

+ You can now get virus if you lose a hack, they can steal DOS coin slowly and cause
 your computer to randomly restart. You must purchase an Anti-Virus sweep from the 
 zeroDay market to get rid of them. 

+ Now if you complete the Doll Maker quest you get bonous DOS Coin.

+ Misc 
	- Tweeked lighting
	- Tweeked post effect settings

With this update, I updated to a newer version of Unity, so their may or may not be some bugs in the game.
If you come across a game breaking bug please be sure to Tweet it to me @thewebpro.

Enjoy guys! This will be the last update for Welcome to the Game II(maybe). 

Looking forward to seeing you guys stream it! 

- Adam

notes.title: Balance Update
notes.content:
Hacking Update. 
As some you noticed I nerfed the hacking exploit the other day, which pretty much allowed players to farm unlimited DOS Coin. Upon this I noticed some players were upset over this, so I made some changes. 

	- Buffed Back Door Hacks: Now when you win a hack you will be awarded better. 
	- Buffed Losing Hacks: Now when you loose a hack you will loose slightly more DOS Coin, and have a higher risk of loosing your notes. 
	- Buffed Hack Levels: You will level up much faster now to get harder hacks to get more DOS Coin. So it's a double edge sword. 
	- Trigger Manual Hack: Lowered the cool down time quite a bit. 

Since I sort of brought back the hacking expolit, the cool down is now at 70 seconds.. from once the hack starts. 
I made it a lot more risky.. the more you abuse it.. the faster the threats will come to get you. So be wise on this. 

Remote VPN Update.
To counter the hacks, I have buffed the remote VPN's quite a bit to generate better DOS Coin.			


- Nerfed Lucas slightly

notes.title: Hack the deep web and hide from hitmen in offbeat horror game Welcome to the Game 2
notes.content:
Welcome to the Game 2 is a first-person horror game about hacking. You play as investigative reporter Clint Edwards, and it's on you to rescue a woman named Amalea from a group of mysterious masked hitmen. Your only clue is a clip of Amalea pleading for help, so to track her down you've got to dive headfirst into the deep web, the portion of the Internet which doesn't register in normal browsers or search engines. 

Your goal is to find eight 'hidden hashes' embedded in the deep web and use them to determine Amalea's location. You work out of a modest city apartment building using a simulated computer complete with a web browser, a notepad, and access to various marketplaces fueled by 'DOScoin.'  

You'll spend most of your time on the simulated computer scanning web pages, source code and surprisingly robust file libraries. Some of the hacking plays out as reflex-based minigames and puzzles, but it's mostly good old-fashioned sleuthing. You'll check pages for hidden links, cross-reference IP addresses, and probably a whole bunch of other things that may give you an inexplicable urge to push your glasses up your nose and/or crack your knuckles.

You also have to protect yourself by covering your tracks and hiding your Internet history. The mysterious masked men after Amalea can just as easily come after you, you see, and gladly will if you slip up and make yourself known. Sometimes they'll simply hack you to steal your DOScoin and undo some of your research, but other times they'll pay your apartment a visit, weapon in hand. To that end, you can earn DOScoin by besting other hackers and use it to purchase concealing gadgets and software, as well as motion sensors for when you do get caught red-handed.

You can't fight back in Welcome to the Game 2, so when the hitmen come a-knockin' all you can do is kill the lights and hope you picked a convincing hiding spot. You've got to lock your doors, watch your windows, and sometimes leave the room entirely to hide elsewhere in your apartment building—like the power room you'll need to visit if the masked hackers fiddle with the fuses. Interestingly, if you have a mic plugged in the game will tap into it and, if you make too much noise by talking or, you know, breathing, nearby hitmen will have an easier time finding you. You can disable this feature, but where's the fun in that? 

Welcome to the Game 2 is now available on Steam for $10.

notes.title: New Update - Doll Maker Quest / Color Blind / Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Bug Fix: Fixed where the motion sensor color would be effected by the Remote VPN
- Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where the motion sensor locations in menu would get double stacked. 
- Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where if a player would go outside on the patio, and go back inside while the door was closing. Which casued the inside audio to be muted. So audio glitches should now be fixed. 
- Bug Fix: Fixed an issue if players grabbed the Wifi Dongle trough the window and would be soft locked on fire escape. 

- Update: Noir - Got a slight buff. 
- Update: Lucas - If you forget to turn your computer off, Lucas will steal quite a bit of your DOS Coin and clear your notes. So be sure to turn computer off!
- Update: The Doll Maker quest now has an achievement if you complete it.
- Update: Color Blind Fix - Now when you place a Remote VPN, the icon on the bottom right will change depending on the length of time to generate DOS Coin
		- Zero Bars: Over 1,000 seconds
		- One Bar: Between 300 and 999 seconds
		- Two Bars: Less then 300 seconds
			
- Minor: Updated skyBREAK invalid command message to tell users to type HELP. 

[b]Pro Tips With Adam:[/b]
- If you turn off all the lights / computer before Lucas attacks. He will be in the room MUCH shorter.
- The WifiDongle upgrades are the most under rated upgrade. Test around with networks. 
- Certain Wifi Networks are pretty much un-traceable by the police.

notes.title: Latest Update - Remote VPN Improvement
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

Been working hard on doing some bug fixes and improvements into the game!

Here are the bug fixes I addressed with this update:

- Made V-Sync On default for all quailty settings
- Fixed skyBREAK spacing issue where the last line would be cut off. 
- Fixed where you would get killed from picking up first package from dead drop. 
- Fixed when the power went off and the tutorial was still playing. 
- Fixed bug where the side door would push player into the wall in alleyway door. 
- Fail safe added if player somehow manages to clip trough a floor it will re-spawn player back in main room.
- Fixed bug where the computer monitor screen would go black, should also address audio glitch where computer audio would go silent. 
- Fixed bug where the Remote VPN menu would get glitched out and Remote VPN values would be over stacked.
- Fixed bug when a user would continue a game and spawn in walls / weird positions. 

[b]Remote VPN Update![/b]
Now when you place a Remote VPN there will be three different color codes depending on the length of time it takes to generate DOS Coin. 

Red - Over 1,000 seconds
Orange - Between 300 and 999 seconds
Green - Less then 300 seconds

This should help out and speed up the farming process. 

*Please note that if you put the Remote VPN BACK on the Wine Rack, it will remain the color it was last at, and will NOT generate any coin, So do NOT be confused by this*

We will continue to address any other bugs we can replicate on our end.

notes.title: Hotfix Updates / Noir Nerf / Important Notes! Please Read
notes.content:
Hey Guys!

I just want to say it’s been amazing to see everyone streaming and making videos of this game. We really enjoy watching people play the game and see their experience. Thank you all for the overwhelming positive support and great reviews! 

Over the past day, we have been pushing updates to the game to address some bugs and balancing issues.
 
I think the biggest issue we are working on is the Noir balancing, I think we have addressed most of the bugs with this latest update, but not 100% sure with the weird teleportation / spawning issues some users have been experience. Hopefully we got it. 

Also PLEASE READ THE UPDATE NOIR DOC ON THE DESKTOP

If you get the bug after updating, if you could please contact us with details on what you did before the events start happening, if you have a video of it.. would be even better. 

A light nerf has been done with Noir as well to make the game a bit easier. 
We really appreciate everyone being patient with us while we iron out the hard to trackbugs, please keep in mind we are a two man team on this project. With me(Adam) being the SOLO programmer. 
 
Some other notes I want to point out. 

[b]If you accidentally changed your resolution too low in the game, and no longer can work the game. Do the following: [/b]

Goto the follow location in your computer:

C:\Users\<YourUserName>\AppData\LocalLow\Reflect Studios\Welcome to the Game II\

Select and delete the file WTTG2OPTDATA.gd

After you have done this, Open up Steam under your library, Right click on Welcome to the Game II and goto Properties. Click on Browse Local Files,  while holding down the Control key.. Double click on WTTG2.exe

This will launch a configuration dialog in which you can change the resolution directly as well as graphics quality. 


[b]If the game crashes on loading..  Try the following. [/b]

In Options turn OFF the mic. 
Try again. 
If that doesn’t work.. 
Lower your quality settings and resolution to about 720p and window mode. 

If that doesn't work.. Please submit us a crash report.. 

To find your crash report go to the following location:

C:\Users\<YourUserName>\AppData\LocalLow\Reflect Studios\Welcome to the Game II\Crashes\

and select the latest file in there. 

send crash report to aflatau@reflectstudios.com with subject line WTTG2 Crash Report and in the body please describe your bug / crash.. 

[b]Game crashes in tutorial.[/b] 
This is an odd bug we are trying to address but we need your help! For now please just hit the RED HANG UP button on the Adam call to SKIP the tutorial for now.. you can look up videos on youtube to see it. 

With that being said.. If you are having this crash please send us a crash log. read just above on instructions on how to do that. 


[b]Pro Tips With Adam[/b]
- You can resize most windows on the desktop by hovering your mouse on the bottom right corner of the window.
- For VPN placement.. each Hall Way is broken down to 8 different sections.. so if one spot is giving you poor farming.. Simply pick it up and move it down just a little bit down the same hallway.. Repeat till you get a good spot before moving to a different floor. 
- Hovering for hot spots WILL NOT BE IN THE SOURCE CODE, that would be too easy. 

Please feel free to leave any suggestions. 

Thanks
- Adam

notes.title: A special contest for Twitch Streamers!
notes.content:
- Are you a Twitch streamer?
- Do you enjoy horror games?
- Do you enjoy Welcome to the Game?

If you answered yes to these three questions then I am proud to announce a special contest to you... 

- What do I win?
  The winner of the contest will be given 10 keys of         Welcome to the Game(1) to give away to their community, but ALSO will be given an ADVANCE EARLY COPY of Welcome to the Game II to stream for their community before any one else! Oh.. and 10 keys of Welcome to the Game II to give away as well!

- How do I win?
  The first person to clip and send me via Twitter or Twitch of you getting ALL THREE endings of Welcome to the Game will be the winner! 

RULES:
- You must have at least 500 followers on Twitch.
- Twitch integration has to be OFF
- Must CLIP the moment of you getting to each ending.
- When taking this clip be sure to have the NOTES with KEYS visible on screen.
- Each ending you have to START A NEW GAME.(Can’t use the same run for all three)
- Can NOT be an advantaged player.(AKA ones who do speed runs, sorry guys)
- Entries can NOT be from previous streams. 

WHEN:
Starts TONIGHT(10/4) @ 8PM EST

GOOD LUCK
